description.value: Yan's Garden (潮樓) is a well-established Cantonese restaurant in Burnaby celebrated for its daily push-cart dim sum service, live seafood, and Peking duck. Seating over 180 guests across a large column-free main hall and three private VIP rooms, it has hosted weddings and large banquets and is recommended by locals and visitors as one of the top Chinese restaurants in the area. The restaurant is situated at the busy corner of Lougheed Highway and North Road with ample on-site parking.

Takeout is confirmed via the dedicated 'Pickup/Delivery Order' section and all-day delivery service. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
